Slow Roll Detroit Thursday Night Ride

Detroit, MI · Milwaukee Junction · Social

No-dropBeginner friendlyFamily

Slow Roll Detroit Thursday Night Ride is a social group ride in Detroit, MI. It rolls every Thursday at 6:30 pm from Chroma Detroit. About 12 miles, easy social pace, 8–10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @slowrolldetroitthursdaynights the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Slow Roll Detroit Thursday Night Ride group ride

The ride that started the Slow Roll movement, back on the streets in 2026 after a pause. Now a Thursday ride of 8 to 12 miles at an easy pace, with a set two-hour window. All bikes and all riders. Register once per season and check the Facebook group for the weekly start point.
